description: Noto Sans glyph ranges bundled with Offline US Maps: every range used by string values in the Illinois Shortbread package (tools/scan_tiles.py) plus a Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and punctuation baseline. Ranges not bundled are served as empty glyph sets. Ranges listed in not_in_font occur in the package (emoji, enclosed alphanumerics) but Noto Sans has no glyphs for them.
